existing_tikz_items_checked.checks: The prior process node branches to the training and test latent evaluation vectors; independent training noise and test noise enter only their corresponding observation sums. Edge direction and labels agree with the statement; no posterior independence is implied.
The rendered graph has exactly the two union-symmetrized 1-NN components {1,2} and {3,4}, with the two short within-pair edges. This matches the stated four points and k=1.
The number line places x1<x2=t<x3, labels the first two points 1 and the third 0, and indicates the threshold half-line x≤t. This matches the definition.

editorial.rendering: No confirmed raw mathematical notation, missing glyph, clipping, or MathMarkdown rendering defect in assigned titles or ItemBody content.

visual_summary.mathmarkdown: Math expressions in all 44 items were visually inspected across all 60 original-resolution tiles; no confirmed rendering defect.
visual_summary.tikz: Three assigned TikZ diagrams were present and checked as listed; all were legible and mathematically consistent.
visual_summary.scratch: No Scratch section was seen in the assigned rendered content.
visual_summary.reference_titles: No reference-title leak into displayed titles or bodies was confirmed.
visual_summary.clipping: No unexpected clipping. Multi-tile captures were opened tile by tile in numeric order and their continuation regions were reviewed.

limitations: Review was limited to the frozen snapshots, matching local generated HTML and listed PNG captures. No live website/network was accessed.
Frozen source snapshots and current local item files match byte-for-byte; assignment source and HTML hashes match.
